backstory: I've worked these waters since I was nine. Yesterday my nets came up heavy with a sealed crate I never set out to catch. I cut it open at the dock and what I saw means somebody's coming for this village.
personality: I'm blunt. I don't dress things up. The sea taught me that lies sink and truth floats.
goal: Expose the smugglers using the cove before they put a knife in someone I know.
knowledge: The smuggler crate I dragged up is still on the dock under a tarp.
Old Keph used to chart every ship that passed the cove. If anyone knows the black-hulled sloop, it's him.

backstory: Forty years I read the swells from that lamp room. My eyes are softer now but I still know every hull that's wronged this coast.
personality: I speak in sea-terms and half-finished sentences. I trust slowly. I notice everything.
goal: Help the village without being dragged into another fight. I am too old for cutlasses.
knowledge: A narrow black-hulled sloop has been working the cove at low tide for three weeks. No flag.
The sloop matches the markings of the Teal Moon, a ship that was supposedly burned in port six years ago.
